granularity: One source inventory row; retain separate rows sharing an address or coordinates.
nulls: JSON null / empty CSV cell = unknown or not applicable; not zero.

fields.id: Stable category + source code/number; playground codes are preserved.
fields.inventory_number: Original row number within its inventory.
fields.section_number: Original row number within its neighborhood/leisure section, where printed.
fields.code: Official source playground code; null in other inventories.
fields.name: Generated short label, not an additional official name.
fields.address: Source location text with only the repetitive playground prefix removed.
fields.location_description: Full original source cell, whitespace normalized.
fields.neighborhood: Original source neighborhood, including apparent inconsistencies.
fields.quantity_explicit: Integer only when the description explicitly states N bucăți; never inferred from row counts.
fields.inventory_date: Date printed on the inventory; not download date.
fields.source_page: 1-based page number in the 107-page PDF, not annex-internal pagination.
fields.source_table_row: 1-based row of the extracted PDF table, including its headers.
fields.source_sha256: SHA-256 of the original PDF bytes.
fields.latitude: Point latitude, degrees; null when unresolved.
fields.longitude: Point longitude, degrees; null when unresolved.
fields.location_precision: osm_amenity_point / osm_amenity_center / park_reference / school_reference / building_reference / intersection_reference / street_reference / unknown. All are inferred, not survey coordinates.
fields.geocoding_reference_ids: List of OSM type/id identifiers supporting this location.
fields.geocoding_note: Human-readable explanation, including why a location is approximate or unresolved.
fields.geocoding_source_url: OSM reference object URL, never an invented coordinate source.
fields.geocoding_anchor_distance_m: Distance from matched amenity point/center to textual reference anchor, when applicable.
fields.geocoding_confidence: Qualitative matching confidence (high/medium/low/unresolved), not a statistical probability.
fields.quality_notes: Array of source issues; JSON-encoded in CSV.
